description: Buy APEX with almost any coin: Bitcoin, Dogecoin, XRP, Cardano, Litecoin, Tron, Bittensor, Kaspa, Filecoin and ~300 more. Returns a deposit address (plus a memo/tag when the chain needs one). Send the coin there; it arrives as USDC on Arc (or ETH on Base for Kaspa/Filecoin) at YOUR arcAddress, then swap it into APEX on our Arc pool: GET https://apexfaucet.xyz/api/arc/swap/quote?token=0x59933F316417C89d9dC5107B30f08C99b774Ea9D&side=buy&amount=<USDC>&from=<your 0x> returns the unsigned transaction (free for APEX), or use https://apexfaucet.xyz/arc/swap/. The coin swap is done by SideShift or Exolix; we never hold your coins. Free to call. List of coins: GET https://apexfaucet.xyz/api/anycoin/coins.

amount.description: how much you will send (required for kas and fil, optional otherwise)

arcAddress.description: your own 0x address: the USDC (or ETH on Base) is paid there

coin.description: ticker, lower case, e.g. btc, doge, xrp, ada, ltc, trx, tao, kas, fil

network.description: its network, e.g. bitcoin, doge, ripple, cardano, litecoin, tron, bittensor, kas, fil (see /api/anycoin/coins)

name: apex_buy_any_coin
